texts: The smell of mire-essence is faintly metallic.

fields.sentence: The smell of mire-essence is faintly metallic.

review.notes: The of-phrase is neither a nominalization's object (no verb paraphrase 'what smells mire-essence') nor a part/component, so the residual opaque Possession is the licensed route; 'faintly' correctly keeps its -ly surface form as the Degree level (derivation, not inflection) and the downtoner keeps the positive property, unlike an approximator. Hyphenated 'mire-essence' fuses with its head genus and the noun modifier unexposed, and the bare mass possessor rightly stays a constant.

Bare kind subject takes `Inheritance`, the noun modifier `mire` is correctly unexposed, and "dark-green-black" is kept as one opaque adjective compound per the leave-adjective-compounds-opaque note. Empirical 0.9/0.9 on the colour claim against definitional 1.0/0.99 on the genus is the dial as written.

Definite plural takes a group witness with the fusing classifier in the kind slot plus its genus (material modifier not exposed, per the steel_beam line), and the distributive predicate correctly keeps the group event alongside the per-member PartOf rule; produce -> Patient (creation) and the inanimate transitive subject -> Agent are both as specified.
